instruction: Access the Executive Office for Immigration Review forms listing.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Executive Office for Immigration Review (ID 437) forms page. Uses same evaluator pattern as original to check URL pattern match.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify URL contains the required query parameters
Metric function properly extracts URL from result (handles both string and dict formats from active_url_from_accessTree getter)
Pattern matching logic is appropriate for navigation task verification
The regex pattern 'forms\\?title=&field_component_target_id=437' will correctly match URLs containing this query string
Minor issue: Pattern lacks domain/path verification - could theoretically match on unintended URLs, though unlikely in practice
Minor issue: Regex pattern is not anchored, so it matches anywhere in URL (using re.search), which could lead to false positives in edge cases
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider making pattern more specific by including domain verification (e.g., justice.gov)
Consider adding path verification to ensure it's actually the forms page path
Consider using more specific regex anchoring if exact query string matching is required
